activity.notes: Traditional Japanese chronology places Prince Shōtoku's appointment as regent under Empress Suiko in 593, and his death in 622. Because the precise constitutional character of the early office is reconstructed through later historical tradition, ATLAS marks the start approximate and confidence likely rather than treating the later regency concept as an unqualified modern office. The Activity represents his political leadership under Suiko and does not treat him as sovereign emperor.
